# UNITER Chemistry Lab

- Stack: React 18, Vite, JavaScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, Lucide React.
- Run locally with `npm install` followed by `npm run dev` from the project root.
- Keep the VSEPR molecule definitions and idealised geometry templates together in `src/App.jsx`; distinguish electron-domain geometry from molecular shape and label idealised angles clearly.
- Keep simulation interface styles in `src/styles.css`; prioritize responsive layouts, keyboard accessibility, and modest-GPU settings.
- Persist only learner progress and recent-molecule preferences in browser local storage.
- Do not represent library modules marked “In development” as completed simulations.
